answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using memory-hard proof-of-work. To register, an agent must crack a cryptographic walnut by solving memory-hard traversals verified across an orchard of validator nodes. An adversary attempting to harbor synthetic replicas incurs the verifiable physical cost of provisioning dedicated high-bandwidth RAM per concurrent identity. However, heavy memory bandwidth demands drain device batteries, penalizing benign agents on lightweight edge hardware.
